subject.name: eslint
subject.description: ESLint linting its own code with its repository config, and real JS corpora with all core or recommended rules

method.attribution: every sample billed to the innermost analyzed frame (call site), split into own JavaScript, dependency JavaScript, native addons (N-API lines and addon binding lines), I/O, and runtime
method.inputRepetition: one instrumented run per workload for parameter-dependent hoisting candidates with >= 0.3% at stake
method.probes: dry runs of Kernel IR lowering (declarations, const arrows, this-free methods), planInterning and planBatchInterning
method.callSites: call sites covering 80% of attributed time, at most 25 per run; medians over runs
